job_description:
AI Engineering - Workingstudent
cognee · Berlin, Berlin, Germany (Hybrid)

We're looking for technical builders who want to work at the frontier of AI infrastructure.

You'll join a small, driven team in Berlin working on one of the most important problems in AI: how agents can remember, reason, adapt, and improve over time.

Role Overview

As an AI Engineer Workingstudent, you will build small, high-quality proof-of-concept applications with Cognee's open-source memory engine.

Your work will sit at the intersection of engineering, research, product, and technical storytelling. You will explore the newest developments in AI, identify relevant use cases, build working demos with Cognee, and turn them into public-facing technical content.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys building fast, learning quickly, and translating technical ideas into clear examples that developers, founders, and AI teams can understand.

You will not just write internal code. You will help shape how people think about AI memory, agents, and the future of AI applications.

What You'll Do

Build small proof-of-concept applications using Cognee's open-source Python SDK
Explore current AI trends, new model capabilities, agent frameworks, and emerging developer workflows
Identify promising use cases where memory, knowledge graphs, retrieval, and feedback loops can improve AI systems
Create demos that show how Cognee can be used in real-world agentic applications
Write technical blog posts, tutorials, and walkthroughs explaining what you built and why it matters
Turn demos into public-facing marketing and developer content for GitHub, X, LinkedIn, Hacker News, and other channels
Work closely with engineering, product, and growth to translate technical experiments into clear product narratives
Help improve documentation, examples, and onboarding materials for developers using Cognee
Test new ideas quickly, document learnings, and suggest improvements to the product based on what you build

Requirements

Here is what we'd like you to bring to the table

Currently studying or recently completed a degree in computer science, AI, data science, engineering, mathematics, or a related technical field
Strong Python skills and comfort working with APIs, SDKs, notebooks, and developer tools
Interest in LLMs, AI agents, RAG, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and AI infrastructure
Ability to build small but polished technical demos independently
Strong written communication skills and interest in explaining technical concepts clearly
Curiosity about the newest developments in AI and the ability to quickly turn ideas into working prototypes
High-agency mindset: you do not wait for perfectly defined tasks, you explore, build, and improve
Experience with GitHub and basic software engineering workflows
Bonus: experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, Hugging Face, Next.js, or similar tools
Bonus: previous technical writing, open-source contributions, hackathon projects, or AI side projects
